skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the main points of short conversations on familiar topics in everyday life.
Understand announcements and instructions in train stations, airports, and over PA systems.
Use 40-60 vocabulary words for greetings, introductions, thanks, and apologies.
Give a solo speech of 1-2 minutes on basic, familiar topics in everyday life.
Communicate for 2-3 minutes in familiar daily life situations such as asking directions, ordering food, and asking for information.
Recognize about 150 vocabulary words from reading passages of up to 200 words on familiar topics in everyday life.
Understand the main points of reading passages of over 200 words on familiar topics in everyday life.
Guess the meaning of words based on context from reading passages of over 300 words on familiar topics in everyday life.
Write simple sentences to construct a text for everyday life communication, including personal information.
Combine simple structures using basic linking devices to construct a text for everyday life communication.
Write a short letter/email to friends about familiar topics in everyday life such as birthday wishes, invitations, and meeting arrangements.
